# expo: typed routes, generated by stack

## Goal
A phone app's `href`s are type-checked against its routes. Expo's own route types are off:
expo-router 56 ships no `expo-router/types`, and `stack expo dev` sets
`EXPO_NO_TYPESCRIPT_SETUP` (story 04), which also stops Expo writing `.expo/types`.

## Approach
Stack generates the route types into `.stack/` from the consumer's route files, the way it
generates the rest of `.stack/`, and the consumer's tsconfig includes them. Check with context7
what expo-router 56 exposes for typing `href` before choosing the generated shape.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] (test) a route file's path type-checks as an `href`; a path with no route file does not.
- [ ] (file) `plugins/expo/guide/routes.md` describes typed routes again.
